name: detail-back-origin
note: S-BACK-ORIGIN (operator UAT 2026-07-17: 'when I'm in the setlist and open a song then hit back, I expect to return to the setlist - I always end up at the library'). The song-detail back button returns to the ORIGIN tab: setlist entries -> Setlist, library entries -> Library. Real flow: save a progression to the setlist, open it FROM the setlist, back -> assert the Setlist screen; then open a song FROM the library, back -> assert the Library screen. Red-first: pre-fix #backLib hard-coded switchTab('library'). SONGS-MERGE phase 1: 'origin' is now a SEGMENT of the Songs surface, not a tab. Back from a setlist-opened song restores the Setlist SEGMENT (and the button says 'Setlist'); reaching the full list from there is a segment switch, not a tab trip - which is why #segAll is tapped before the All-list row.

steps.label: the detail's back button names its true origin (Back to Setlist)

back from a SETLIST-opened song returns to the SETLIST (pre-fix: always the library) (SONGS-MERGE: the setlist is a SEGMENT now - assert the segment is selected and its body is on screen, not that a retired tab button is active)
back from a LIBRARY-opened song still returns to the LIBRARY
